sections.text: You look at science (or at least talk of it) as some sort of demoralising invention of man, something apart from real life, and which must be cautiously guarded and kept separate from everyday existence. But science and everyday life cannot and should not be separated.– Rosalind Franklin (1920-1958), British chemist and X-ray crystallographer
